data.exact_reserve_text: In the 2014 calendar year, the 2014, 2013 and 2012 & prior years of account have all contributed profits (2014: GBP 4.0m; 2013: GBP 3.8m: 2012 & prior: GBP 23.5m). Syndicate 958 has benefitted from positive reserve development relating to prior periods. An improvement in the old years' catastrophe events resulted in reserve releases across the Global Property and Global Specialty business units, which includes favourable developments on Casualty and Motor XL classes on older years of account.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2014 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 417.6m. During 2014 the syndicate reported material favourable prior-year reserve development, driven by improvements on older catastrophe events and favourable development on casualty and motor XL classes. The managing agent reports that prior years (2013 and 2012 & prior) contributed profits totalling GBP 27.3m to calendar year 2014 results, reflecting net releases from older years. Named current-year catastrophe exposure included Hurricane Odile (net ultimate ~GBP 1.1m).

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet liabilities 'Claims outstanding' (2013 comparative column). No explicit gross 'movement in prior years' note was located in the provided text; prior-year development was derived from the managing agent's year-of-account contribution breakdown (2013: GBP 3.8m; 2012 & prior: GBP 23.5m) which was used as the primary quantified prior-year movement (-GBP 27.3m = release). The per-line run-off table appears to show favourable/(adverse) run-off deviations (values in GBP 000) and was used to populate lob_movements; that table is labelled 'Net claims outstanding' and may be net of reinsurance in presentation-users should treat per-line amounts as indicative (confidence scores reflect this). No gross claims development triangle was found in the supplied pages.
